response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, versatile senior software engineer with broad web, mobile, and some embedded/C experience, but he lacks the core requirements for this role: no native or listed Japanese proficiency, no demonstrated Linux kernel investigation/modification experience, and no security-domain expertise (MACsec, 802.1X, Captive Portal, tamper detection). His recent career is heavily focused on full-stack web/TypeScript development rather than embedded C/UNIX systems work, making him a poor fit despite his general engineering strength.
strengths: Extensive, long-tenured senior/staff-level software engineering experience
Some C/C++ background (National Instruments, embedded audio project) and Linux familiarity
Strong self-driven learner with open-source, teaching, and workshop experience showing technical depth
concerns: No Japanese language listed among skills, and native-level fluency is a hard requirement
No evidence of Linux kernel source investigation or modification experience
No experience with required security technologies (MACsec, 802.1X, Captive Portal, tamper/attack detection) or switch networking (L2/L3, NETCONF, SNMP)

key_factors.factor: No Linux kernel or embedded security experience
